# Parse schedule note content

        # Extract number and unit
        match = re.search(r'=>\s*([\d.]+)\s*(minutes|hours)', line)
        if match:
            value = float(match.group(1))
            unit = match.group(2)
            if unit == 'hours':

            else:

    else:

print(f"Total Today task minutes: {today_minutes}")

remaining = work_minutes - today_minutes
